title: Retain the scene when a native response stops
changes: An interrupted native response retains the exact last delivered scene and records the unfinished request. Before, Live, record download and Reset remain available.
The normal patch trial was slower in the short glass/oak/iron comparisons and timed out on ice. Its native option is withdrawn; only a compiled analytical CPU reference is retained.
Simulation speed remains about 0.05x realtime in the default glass drop. This checkpoint does not improve solver speed or change the native material laws.
The active objective now includes near realtime fracture, dents, bounce, heat, burning and power with visible 3D demonstrations. Unsupported laws remain unimplemented.
